title: Reason in the Words You Speak: Idiolectal Paraphrasing Off-Policy Traces for Reasoning Distillation in VideoLLMs
keywords: Reason in the Words You Speak
abstract: Recent large language models achieve strong performance on complex reasoning tasks, where reinforcement learning with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has emerged as a leading paradigm for optimizing models on self-generated trajectories. However, the on-policy nature of GRPO bounds the model to the reasoning skills it can already produce, restricting to learn more advanced capabilities. Prior works inject privileged reasoning traces from a stronger teacher policy to guide training, yet these traces are inherently out of distribution with respect to the student policy. We observe that this mismatch between on-policy and off-policy causes gradient clipping on semantically critical reasoning tokens, ultimately rewarding correct answers while leaving the reasoning that justifies them unlearned. Hence, we propose \textbf{Echo-GRPO}, a framework that lets the model reason in the words it speaks. Rather than imitating low-probability privileged traces from the teacher model, Echo-GRPO rewrites them into the student policy's own \textit{idiolect}, that is, its own characteristic vocabulary and expression patterns, while preserving their semantics via Dual-Reference Decoding. We instantiate this framework as \textbf{VideoEcho-R1} for video reasoning distillation, achieving consistent improvements across three multimodal LLM backbones and five benchmarks. Finally, we show that our idiolectal paraphrasing is a plug-in module that consistently improves both RL and supervised fine-tuning frameworks for reasoning distillation, demonstrating that policy-aligned supervision extends beyond GRPO.

analysis.ideaZh: Echo-GRPO 将 teacher reasoning 改写为 student idiolect，并以两种 reference 的分布组合控制 mixed-policy clipping。v2 实质纠正了消融与成本解释：作者报告 prompt-only rewriting 的旧均值被上调，使完整方法的额外收益缩小。应更新科学判断；方法本身未改变。
analysis.motivationZh: 教师推理的表达分布可能偏离 video student，影响 off-policy 学习；目标是保留推理语义，并改写成 student 更易吸收的 idiolect。
analysis.methodZh: 同模型两路 decoding，一路带 privileged trace 确保语义候选，一路无 trace 按 native question prompt 评词概率，合成离线 paraphrases 后替换 GRPO 的 teacher rollout。三 VLM backbones、五 video QA/reasoning benchmarks 与 SFT 插件验证改写价值。相对 receipt-backed v1，本次 v2 主要修正 prompt-only baseline 及三 benchmark cost-table GRPO baseline，收窄 DRD 增益，而非新增方法或新的 benchmark 突破；应该以更正后的 trade-off 更新既有记录。
methodFlow: 从 stronger teacher 取得 video/question 的 privileged reasoning trace。
初始 student 分别以带 trace semantic prompt 与不带 trace native prompt 产生 next-token 分布。
只保留 semantic reference top-k，并与 native 分布相乘、归一后逐 token 改写。
将 cached idiolectal trace 替换一个 mixed-policy rollout，以 accuracy/length rewards 进行 GRPO。
部署只运行训练后的 VideoLLM；同离线改写也可替换 SFT targets。
analysis.experimentsZh:
实验设置：2.4K OneThinker multiple-choice video instances，teacher Seed1.5-VL；InternVL3.5-4B、Qwen3-VL-4B/8B 统一 8frames 与 6rollouts。五主要 video benchmarks，额外三 math benchmarks、SFT→GRPO 和 9K scale-up；本次科学更新集中已有消融与成本解释数字修正。
作者报告 v2 prompt-only rewriting mean56.9 vsDRD58.2，DRD 额外 1.3points；offline cost9.4 vs163.9ms/token。（Table4, p.7; Table10, p.17）
作者报告 Qwen3-VL-4B 五 benchmark average57.2 vsGRPO55.9；8B 则 58.2 与 GRPO58.2 持平，VSI-Bench49.1 低于 GRPO51.1。（Table2, p.7）
作者报告 9K scale-up Echo58.2 vsGRPO56.4，即 1.8point gain；clipping7.9% vs7.8%，低 clip 本身不能解释全部提升。（Table9, p.17）
比较范围：含 SFT、GRPO、mixed-policy、LUFFY、OPSD 与 generic/prompt-only/single-reference variants，许多近似方法有 adaptation；teacher/input/data 仍小规模，某些 numerical spatial tasks 并不优于 on-policy GRPO。
消融与诊断：random-vs-semantic unclipping 支持 token identity 作用，但 semantic importance 代理主要是 query/options nouns；v2 更正后简单 student rewriting 已获多数收益。top-k10 降至 53.4 说明 semantic drift 风险；没有严格 fact-preservation 证明或完整 uncertainty 估计。
analysis.insightZh: 原方法将 student-style paraphrasing 用作 off-policy distillation 的数据接口，并以 dual-reference decoding 权衡 semantics 与 probability；v2 不改变此机制。真正 scientific delta 是 ablation baseline 与离线 cost/performance 数字的更正，减少相对简单 rewriting 和 GRPO 的额外效果，必须避免沿用旧版较大 gain。
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 为多模态 teacher traces 的 policy-compatible 训练提供参考；当前最有价值的是修正 DRD 相对简单 rewriting 的增益与成本，不把已有工作再次包装为新模型发布。
analysis.evidenceZh:
DRD 用初始 student 的 semantic top-k 与无 privileged context 的 native distributions 做 product-of-experts，rewritten traces 离线缓存。（Sec.3.3, Fig.3–4, Eq.2, pp.5–6; Appendix E, p.17；方法图与成本表实际查看；相乘不是严格 on-policy sampling 保证。）
v2 Table4 将 prompt-only student rewriting 的 MMVU/Video-Holmes 改为 67.8/44.9、mean56.9，v1 为 66.6/43.3、mean56.0；DRD58.2 未变。（v1/v2 Table4, p.7; Sec.4.4, p.9；两 exact versions 对应表实际视觉对比，DRD 增量由 2.2 变为 1.3 点；并非仅 stamp 更改。）
v2 Table10 的 three-benchmark GRPO baseline 为 56.0，Echo without/with DRD 为 56.9/58.2；v1 baseline55.6 与 gain1.3/2.6 被修正为 0.9/2.2。（v1/v2 Appendix E, Table10, p.17；两成本页均实际查看；9.4/163.9ms per token 不变，额外 DRD 效果与 preprocessing 成本需一起解读。）
v2 将 9K 实验对 vanilla GRPO gain 更正为 1.8 点，原 v1 正文误写 4.7；Table9 本身 58.2 vs56.4 未变。（v1/v2 Appendix D.4, Table9 and following text, p.17；这是结论可信度相关的 numerical correction，不是新增 run。）
旧 receipt、review 和 PDF SHA 均匹配 assignment provenance；全文 diff 还包括 NeurIPS footer、引用与 grammar 修正。（content/paper-reading/runs/2026-08-29.json; archived 2608.26684v1 PDF/review；未覆盖旧 audit artifacts；venue/footer 不是单独触发收录的理由。）
analysis.caveatZh:
DRD 增加离线双 forward-per-token preprocessing 成本，cached traces 后部署不增加 decoding overhead。
teacher reasoning quality 限制 rewrites，numerical precision 任务可能减益。
pretraining/evaluation 潜在 overlap 带来 implicit leakage 风险。
native/semantic probability 乘积与 top-k 不保证每个 teacher 事实被保持，不能把 rewriting 称作严格 on-policy 证明。
大幅优于 naive Mixed-Policy 主要反映该 baseline 显著退化；对强 GRPO 或 prompt-only rewriting 的实际 gain 较小。
成本表和 scale-up 文字曾有实质数值错误；本轮只采用 v2 更正值，并保留未报告重复 variance 的边界。
所有数字均为作者报告，本项目未复现。
